completion:
Include the number of years of experience of the inspectors.
3. Include the name (brand) and model of the inspection device.
4. List all the relevant documents you used during the inspection.  
5. Include a description of 'what' happened during the inspection, in detail.
6. Include 'why' it happened, and any relevant factors  
7. Mention any follow up actions or questions you have for other colleagues or managers
